message.content: I usually wake up around six in the morning, like a clock. I have some yoghurt for breakfast, then I get dressed and ride my bike to the bakery. The bike ride is pretty short, maybe ten minutes. I like the routine because it feels calm. Sometimes, when I'm on the bike, I hear a voice, but it doesn't last long. I just keep going. At the bakery, I start by labeling the bread trays and wrapping the loaves. The work is repetitive, which helps me focus. I don't like it when I don't sleep well because then the voice seems louder. But most days, things go smoothly.
